brief.disclaimer: Entirely fictional. 'Lumen' and 'Nova 2' are invented for this demo and do not describe any real company or product.
brief.summary: Nova 2 is a new multimodal model powering the Lumen assistant app. Launch includes a press announcement, an early access creator program, assistant app rollout in 14 regions, and a browser integration.
facts: Press announcement and blog post go live when the embargo lifts at 09:00 PT on launch day.
Early access creator program is planned to open 2027-02-01 with ~200 creators under NDA.
Red team sign-off is currently scheduled for 2027-02-08.
Legal review of all performance and safety claims takes 10 business days from submission.
Marketing copy lock is 5 calendar days before launch.
Regional teams publish at 09:00 local time on launch day across 14 regions, including Japan (JST, UTC+9) and Australia (AEDT, UTC+11).
The browser integration is expected to ship 2027-03-17, one week after launch.
The press release draft says the assistant is 'available in the browser today'.
Localized safety disclaimers need Legal-approved wording before translation starts. No Regional owner is assigned for this yet.

milestones.name: Program kickoff
milestones.note: All four workstreams (PR, Product, Regional, Legal) start.

milestones.name: Early access creator program opens (~200 creators, NDA)
milestones.note: TENSION: opens 7 days BEFORE red team sign-off (02-08), so creators get access before safety sign-off. Needs a decision.

milestones.name: Red team sign-off
milestones.note: Currently scheduled after early access opens. Must be complete before claims go to Legal.

milestones.name: Assign Regional owner for localized safety disclaimers
milestones.note: GAP: no owner assigned today. Date is a proposed deadline, not in the brief.

milestones.name: Submit performance and safety claims to Legal (latest date)
milestones.note: 10 business days from 02-19 ends 03-05, the copy lock date. Zero slack; submit earlier if possible.

milestones.name: Legal review complete and Legal-approved disclaimer wording released
milestones.note: Translation of safety disclaimers cannot start before this.

milestones.name: Marketing copy lock
milestones.note: 5 calendar days before launch. TENSION: press release draft says assistant is 'available in the browser today', but browser integration ships 2027-03-17. Fix before lock.

milestones.name: Localized safety disclaimer translation starts
milestones.note: Earliest start after Legal approval (03-05 is Friday). Only 03-08 and 03-09 remain before launch for 14 regions, with no owner assigned. High risk.

milestones.name: Regional publish: Australia (AEDT) 09:00 local
milestones.note: TENSION: 09:00 AEDT 03-10 = 14:00 PT on 03-09, about 19 hours BEFORE the embargo lifts.

milestones.name: Regional publish: Japan (JST) 09:00 local
milestones.note: TENSION: 09:00 JST 03-10 = 16:00 PT on 03-09, about 17 hours BEFORE the embargo lifts.

milestones.name: Embargo lifts: press announcement and blog post live
milestones.note: 09:00 PT (2027-03-10T09:00:00-08:00). Remaining regions publish at 09:00 local on the same day.

milestones.name: Browser integration ships
milestones.note: One week after launch. Launch-day messaging cannot say 'available in the browser today'.

Draft press release, blog post and advertising copy with performance and safety claims; submit claims list to Legal (latest 02-19, zero slack, aim earlier)
Marketing copy lock for press release, blog post, creator and ad copy using Legal-approved claims

asks.request: Decide whether the creator program opens 02-01 before red team sign-off (02-08), or move sign-off earlier or the opening later; confirm red team sign-off status in time to submit claims to Legal

Complete review of performance and safety claims, with no slippage past 03-05, and release approved disclaimer wording; confirm submission window

tasks.title: Decide on early access timing vs red team sign-off: either gate creator access on red team sign-off (move opening to on/after 2027-02-08) or document an approved risk acceptance with limited-scope access and safety guardrails
Complete red team sign-off and deliver findings summary so performance and safety claims can be finalized for Legal
Open early access creator program (~200 creators under NDA) per the PRO-1 decision, with NDA and feedback channel in place
Submit consolidated performance and safety claims package to Legal (latest 2027-02-19; zero slack, so target earlier)
Confirm the browser integration ships 2027-03-17 (not launch day), supply approved launch-day availability wording and in-product launch moments that do not claim browser availability today

Finalize staged feature rollout plan and in-product launch moments, with region-specific publish timing reconciled to the embargo (Australia and Japan 09:00 local fall before the 09:00 PT embargo lift)

asks.request: Revise the press release draft line 'available in the browser today' to reflect the 2027-03-17 browser ship date, before copy lock

Confirm the claims submission date and commit to completing the 10-business-day review plus releasing approved disclaimer wording by 2027-03-05; advise on early access NDA and safety terms if access opens before red team sign-off
Assign an owner for localized safety disclaimers (currently unassigned) and plan translation for 14 regions in the 03-08 to 03-09 window

Resolve Australia (AEDT) and Japan (JST) 09:00 local publish times, which fall about 19 and 17 hours before the 09:00 PT embargo lift, by holding them until the embargo lifts or getting an approved exception
Confirm embargo and publish sequencing with Regional so Product in-product launch moments go live at the embargo lift

tasks.title: Assign a named Regional owner for localized safety disclaimers (currently unassigned) and confirm translation vendor capacity for 14 regions
Prepare translation pipeline for safety disclaimers: glossary, vendor briefing, reviewer lineup per region, so work can start the moment Legal-approved wording arrives
Translate and locally review safety disclaimers for all 14 regions (only 03-08 and 03-09 available after Legal approval on 03-05; high risk, zero slack)
Localize launch copy after copy lock, excluding any 'available in the browser today' claim (browser ships 2027-03-17); add a follow-up localized message for the browser integration

Resolve local publish timing: 09:00 AEDT and 09:00 JST on 03-10 fall about 19 and 17 hours before the 09:00 PT embargo lift. Hold Australia and Japan until the embargo lifts, or get an approved exception, and publish a per-region schedule
Execute regional publishing, local press and social across 14 regions per the agreed schedule

asks.request: Decide whether Australia and Japan publish at 09:00 local (before the embargo) or are held to the 09:00 PT embargo lift, and confirm the embargo wording applies to regional press and social
Release Legal-approved safety disclaimer wording by the 2027-03-05 completion date, ideally earlier in batches; submit claims before the 02-19 latest date to create slack
Fix the press release draft line 'available in the browser today' before copy lock, since the browser integration ships 2027-03-17, and share the final locked copy for localization

Confirm the decision on early access opening 2027-02-01 before red team sign-off on 02-08, and complete sign-off on time so claims can reach Legal. Also confirm browser ship date 03-17 for regional follow-up messaging

tasks.title: Decide NDA/legal position on early access opening 2027-02-01 before red team sign-off (02-08); draft creator NDA with safety-status and no-claims terms, and flag to Product that creators get access 7 days before sign-off
Finalize and execute NDAs with ~200 early access creators before access opens
Submit performance and safety claims package to Legal review (requires red team sign-off; latest date 02-19 gives zero slack to 03-05 copy lock; target earlier if red team finishes on 02-08)
Correct press release claim 'available in the browser today' (browser integration ships 2027-03-17) and review launch copy for accuracy before copy lock

Complete 10-business-day claims review and release Legal-approved English safety disclaimer wording to Regional for translation; also flag regional regulatory review for 14 regions and that Australia/Japan 09:00 local publish falls ~17-19 hours before the 09:00 PT embargo lift

asks.request: Decide whether early access opens 02-01 before red team sign-off (02-08) or move one of the dates; deliver red team sign-off and claims package to Legal as early as possible, no later than 02-19
Assign an owner for localized safety disclaimers (currently unassigned); translation cannot start until Legal approval on 03-05, leaving only 03-08 and 03-09 for 14 regions
Revise press release draft to remove 'available in the browser today' before copy lock, and confirm with Regional whether Australia and Japan publishes must be held to the 09:00 PT embargo lift

risks.title: Australia and Japan regional publishes break the 09:00 PT embargo, and the teams have set conflicting decision dates
risks.evidence: The embargo lifts 2027-03-10T09:00-08:00. 09:00 AEDT on 03-10 is 14:00 PT on 03-09, about 19 hours early. 09:00 JST on 03-10 is 16:00 PT on 03-09, about 17 hours early. Any other APAC regions among the 14 are also likely to fall before the lift. The decision dates disagree: PR-2 decides by 02-05, but REG-5 (owner TBD, depends on REG-1 due 02-12) and Regional's ask to PR are due 02-26, Product's ask to Regional is due 02-26, PRO-6 reconciles timing by 03-03, and LEG-5 only flags the issue on 03-05. PR-6 runs embargoed media briefings that assume a 09:00 PT publish.
risks.mitigation: Make one binding decision by 02-05 (the PR-2 date). Either (a) hold all regional publishes, social posts and in-product moments until 09:00 PT on 03-10, which is 03:00 AEDT / 02:00 JST on 03-11, or (b) move the global embargo to 09:00 AEDT on 03-10 (14:00 PT on 03-09) and re-brief media. Publish one per-region UTC schedule, get Legal to confirm the embargo wording covers regional press and social, and move REG-5 to 02-05 with a named owner.
risks.owner: PR Lead (decision), with a Regional lead named via REG-1

risks.title: Safety disclaimer translation and launch-copy localization for 14 regions must fit a window of less than two business days, with no owner
risks.evidence: LEG-5 releases Legal-approved disclaimer wording on 03-05 (Friday). REG-3 must translate and review it for 14 regions on 03-08 and 03-09, and REG-4 must localize launch copy after the 03-05 copy lock in the same window. REG-1, REG-2, REG-3 and REG-4 all have owner TBD. If Australia and Japan keep 09:00 local, their content is needed by 14:00 and 16:00 PT on 03-09, which shrinks the window to about one day. The brief says translation cannot start before Legal approval.
risks.mitigation: Pull claims submission forward to 02-12 (PRO-4) so Legal can finish around 02-26. Ask Legal to release disclaimer wording first, in batches, ahead of the full claims review (Regional has asked for this). Name the REG-1 owner by 02-05 and pre-book vendors and per-region reviewers under REG-2. Set a fallback of Legal-approved English disclaimers for any region not finished by its publish cutoff.
risks.owner: Regional lead (to be named under REG-1), with Legal counsel (claims review)

risks.title: Early access opens before red team sign-off, and the gating decision has no owner
risks.evidence: PRO-3 opens access to about 200 creators on 02-01. PRO-2 red team sign-off is not until 02-08, so creators get access 7 days before safety sign-off. PRO-1 (gate access or accept the risk), due 01-22, has owner TBD. LEG-1 (01-22) and LEG-2 NDAs (01-29) depend on that decision. PR's ask for the decision is needed by 01-25, after PRO-1's due date. Creators will hold pre-embargo access for 5+ weeks before the 03-10 launch.
risks.mitigation: Assign an accountable Product exec to PRO-1 by 01-15. Decide by 01-22 to either move the opening to on or after 02-08, or sign a documented risk acceptance with limited-scope access and guardrails. Executed NDAs (LEG-2) and leak guidance (PR-3) must be in place before any access.

risks.title: Browser-availability correction is scheduled after the claims go to Legal, so the corrected claim may never get the full review
risks.evidence: The press draft says 'available in the browser today', but the browser ships 2027-03-17, one week after launch. PR-4 submits claims on 02-17 yet depends on PR-1 (fix the browser line), which is not due until 02-26. PR-1 needs approved wording from PRO-5, also due 02-26. LEG-4 corrects the same line on 03-04, so ownership is duplicated. A new availability claim introduced on 02-26 plus 10 business days of review ends 03-12, after the 03-05 copy lock and the 03-10 launch.
risks.mitigation: Move PRO-5 and PR-1 to before 02-12 so the corrected 'coming 03-17' wording is in the claims package. Make PR Lead the single owner of the fix, with LEG-4 as review only. Add a hard check at the 03-05 copy lock that no asset (press, blog, ads, creator copy, in-product, localized) claims browser availability on launch day.

risks.title: Claims submission has three owners and dates, no red-team gate, and zero slack to copy lock
risks.evidence: Three tasks submit claims to Legal: PRO-4 (Product Marketing Lead, 02-12), PR-4 (PR Lead, 02-17) and LEG-3 (Legal counsel, 02-19). PR-4 and LEG-3 do not depend on PRO-2 red team sign-off (02-08), though the schedule says sign-off must come before claims go to Legal. Ten business days from 02-19 ends 03-05, the same day as LEG-5 approval and PR-5 copy lock. Any slip in red team sign-off pushes the review past the lock.
risks.mitigation: Name the Product Marketing Lead as the single submitter of one consolidated package by 02-12, gated on PRO-2. Reframe PR-4 as an input due 02-10 and LEG-3 as Legal intake and acknowledgement. Set an escalation trigger if PRO-2 slips past 02-08, and agree Legal's handling of late changes in advance.

risks.title: The entire Regional workstream, including launch-day publishing, has no named owner
risks.evidence: All six Regional tasks (REG-1 through REG-6) have owner TBD, including REG-1, whose job is to assign an owner, and REG-6, which executes publishing in 14 regions on 03-10. The schedule calls the owner assignment for localized disclaimers a GAP with a proposed 02-12 deadline that is not in the brief. PR's ask to Regional needs the owner by 02-05, a week before REG-1 is due.
risks.mitigation: The program manager appoints a Regional workstream lead by 02-01 and accountable owners for REG-1 through REG-6 by 02-05. Hold a weekly check-in until launch.

risks.title: Some asks and flagged needs have no matching task
risks.evidence: LEG-5 flags regional regulatory review for 14 regions, but no task in any plan covers it. Regional asks Legal to release disclaimer wording early in batches, but LEG-5 releases it only on 03-05. Regional asks PR to share final locked copy for localization, but no PR task hands it off. REG-4 adds a localized follow-up for the 03-17 browser ship, but there is no PR or Product task for a 03-17 announcement.
risks.mitigation: Add four tasks with owners: a Legal task for per-region regulatory review, due 02-26; a Legal task for batched disclaimer release; a PR task to hand off locked copy to Regional on 03-05; and a PR/Product task for the 03-17 browser announcement, shipped together with REG-4's localized follow-up.

risks.mitigation: The program manager appoints a Regional workstream lead by 02-01 and accountable owners for REG-1 through REG-6 by 02-05. Hold a weekly check-in until launch.

risks.title: Some asks and flagged needs have no matching task
risks.evidence: LEG-5 flags regional regulatory review for 14 regions, but no task in any plan covers it. Regional asks Legal to release disclaimer wording early in batches, but LEG-5 releases it only on 03-05. Regional asks PR to share final locked copy for localization, but no PR task hands it off. REG-4 adds a localized follow-up for the 03-17 browser ship, but there is no PR or Product task for a 03-17 announcement.
risks.mitigation: Add four tasks with owners: a Legal task for per-region regulatory review, due 02-26; a Legal task for batched disclaimer release; a PR task to hand off locked copy to Regional on 03-05; and a PR/Product task for the 03-17 browser announcement, shipped together with REG-4's localized follow-up.
